name: part.step: one valid solid

no exploded dimension text on the DIM layer
DIMENSION geometry x DIMLFAC = dims.json value (+-0.005)
dimension text shows the value (thread callouts show the thread)
DIMENSION defpoints = dims.json 3D points through views.json (+-0.02 sheet mm)

every diameter / radius is a cylinder of the STEP with that axis
overall X / Y / Z dimensioned
drawn views = fresh HLR of the STEP (<= 0.05 mm both ways)

every frame within 25 mm of its feature, or directly under the size callout it controls
position frames refer to A|B|C datums only
no text touches a line, an arrow or another text
no leader crosses a dimension line, a GD&T frame, a datum box or a TED box
